Call Appearance Functions

Calling Back an Unavailable Party

This section describes the functions you can use to manage a callback request. To set up a callback request, you call the TELCallbackSet function. When you are notified that a remote party is no longer busy or desires a callback, you can use the TELCallbackNow function to respond to the callback notice. To clear a callback request set up either locally or remotely, you use the TELCallbackClear function.
